purpose: Challenge the selected cross-session absolute-return-clock persistence mechanism against all nearby frozen families before any Campaign057 source partition or value is read.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_day_over_day_absolute_return_profile_similarity_238b
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: High repetition of a stock's normalized 238-bin absolute-return clock on consecutive accepted sessions may indicate persistent information-release or execution timing relevant to a three-session holding horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: Construct 119 within-half absolute log-close returns in each half for both the signal session and its exact accepted-calendar predecessor, normalize each 238-bin session vector, and return equal-mixture natural-log Jensen-Shannon similarity 1-JSD/ln(2).
selected_mechanism.previous_session_definition: immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session; never previous observed stock day across a suspension or missing session

design_choices_frozen_before_values.return_definition: adjacent natural-log closes separately within each half

overlap_challenges.reason: Campaign056 measures cross-session persistence of CNY activity mass and is invariant to all prices. Campaign057 measures cross-session persistence of absolute close-return mass and is invariant to amount; either profile can change while the other remains fixed.

Campaign040 and range entropy use contemporaneous high-low ranges and compare halves or concentration within one session. Campaign057 uses close-to-close absolute returns, compares dates, and reads no high or low.

Campaign027 correlates signed morning and afternoon returns inside one date. Campaign057 discards sign, uses a probability-distance statistic, and compares the full two-half clock across consecutive dates.

Those terminal factors summarize adjacency, concentration, frequency content, or multi-scale variance inside one session. Campaign057 contains no within-session serial or spectral comparison and asks whether absolute-return mass recurs at the same clock bins on the next accepted date.

Exact-zero absolute returns affect the normalized support, so sparse price updating may correlate with Campaign057. The fixed all-80 uniqueness screen must reject it if this confound dominates; no threshold, zero removal, or residualization is allowed.
Campaign053 compares amount mass with same-session absolute-return mass. Campaign057 never reads amount and compares the stock's absolute-return mass only with its own prior accepted session.
Campaign057 loads no market or peer benchmark and cannot distinguish common from idiosyncratic volatility. It measures only the stock's own cross-date clock persistence.

Candidate49 counts ordered close crossings around a causal same-session cumulative VWAP and requires volume. Campaign057 has no price anchor or crossing, reads no volume, and remains historical-only without Candidate49 backfill.
Campaign057 computes one raw two-session close statistic. It loads no terminal factor value and contains no fitted weight, regime, filter, threshold, subset, combination, or model.

decision.next_action: Freeze one exact coverage-first 80-comparison no-return protocol, with one conditional development trial only if admitted, before implementing or reading Campaign057 source values.
